//: Pi model registry overrides for the OpenZerg attacker pod. The qwen/qwen3.7-plus model upstream (Alibaba) rejects requests whose system message is sent with the newer OpenAI 'developer' role, returning HTTP 400 'developer is not one of [system, assistant, user, tool, function]'. We define it as a custom model here so supportsDeveloperRole=false is respected.

openrouter.//modelOverrides: qwen/qwen3.7-plus is a BUILT-IN OpenRouter model, so per-model tweaks go under modelOverrides (not models, which is for NEW models). maxTokens caps the output-token request: pi otherwise asks for up to 65536, which OpenRouter rejects with HTTP 402 when the affordable amount is lower (killing every probe) and is wasteful. 8192 fits a tight credit budget and cuts per-pod cost ~8x. supportsDeveloperRole=false keeps the Alibaba 400 fix.
